target: Push the still-expanding TargetGroundedRefutation frontier from 60 to the full 120-second solver boundary before changing representation or adding a constructor.

inputs.selection_rule: Exactly the three rows whose clause and round frontiers strictly increased from 30 to 60 seconds in the frozen first separator.

live_rivals.H_search_resource: A replayed, Lean-accepted proof appears by 120 seconds.
live_rivals.H_selection_continuation: The frontier continues expanding without proof, keeping selection/search live but not establishing missing capability.
live_rivals.H_frontier_closure: The 120-second run reaches the same terminal frontier as 60 seconds and can be reclassified as closed under this route.
live_rivals.H_constructor_language: An internal proof replays but its emitted Lean certificate is rejected.
live_rivals.H_infrastructure: The 60-second control fails to reproduce its prior qualitative expanding/stable classification because of measurement or runtime failure.

resource_budget: At most 540 nominal search-seconds across six attempts; no parameter grid, no new operator, no solver mutation.

outcome_to_action.official_hit: Freeze and attack the hit with repetitions, alpha-renaming, and operation-dual controls before production integration.
outcome_to_action.expands_without_hit: Map clause selection and frontier composition; do not claim capability failure.
outcome_to_action.stable_without_hit: Move the row to the closed residual set and inspect shared closure/representation constraints.
outcome_to_action.infrastructure_mismatch: Repair measurement without changing scientific limits and rerun.
